mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen each of the last three weeks (-18.0 to -10.9), indicating positive momentum in retail footfall recovery that is likely to persist via habit formation and continued partial reopening of non-essential stores, pushing the 4-week mean higher.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC increased monotonically from -18.0 to -10.9 over the last 4 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's 4-week forward mean is lower than its 4-week trailing mean despite three consecutive weeks of prior increase.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise over the next two weeks despite WORKPLACES dropping more than 5 points week-on-week.
